content.title: Mobility Payoff | Vehicle Capability Becomes a Human Benefit
content.summary: In a very short space, the identity of the vehicle, departure, performance jump, spatial arrival and the final use result of the person are strung together into a causal chain; technological wonders must be realized by specific life results, and the ending cannot stop at a purposeless speed.

quick_start.input_format: Vehicle and starting point + 1 ability jump to change the way of transportation + traceable route + arrival object macro + actual use results of the character
quick_start.recommended_input: The medical boat on the river left the solar clinic, unfolded its hydrofoils and crossed the shallow reed area to reach the flooded village; the cooling medicine capsule was displayed in macro, and finally the nurse loaded the capsule into the damaged seedling incubator.
required_anchors: Establish the carrier and departure point before accelerating the route.
Use one visible capability upgrade that changes how the carrier traverses space.
Present the delivered object or service in tactile close detail at arrival.
End with a beneficiary visibly using the result.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: In a very short space, the identity of the vehicle, departure, performance jump, spatial arrival and the final use result of the person are strung together into a causal chain; technological wonders must be realized by specific life results, and the ending cannot stop at a purposeless speed.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: A mobility proof becomes meaningful when an identified carrier departs, demonstrates one unmistakable capability upgrade, crosses a legible route, arrives at a specific destination, and hands the sequence to a human-scale benefit. The beneficiary action must visibly consume or use the delivered result rather than merely posing beside it.

invariants.rule: Establish the carrier and departure point before accelerating the route.
invariants.purpose: Gives the journey a concrete origin.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening mid-flight removes the state change and route promise.

invariants.rule: Use one visible capability upgrade that changes how the carrier traverses space.
invariants.purpose: Creates a technical proof rather than ordinary travel.
invariants.ablation_failure: Decorative light with no route effect is not an upgrade.

invariants.rule: Preserve a readable destination transition instead of random travel montage.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated locations make the journey untraceable.

invariants.rule: Present the delivered object or service in tactile close detail at arrival.
invariants.purpose: Turns distance into a concrete result.
invariants.ablation_failure: Skipping arrival detail leaves the benefit abstract.

invariants.rule: End with a beneficiary visibly using the result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A product beauty shot does not prove human benefit.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
